name: Space Pioneers [ALPHA 10]
desc:
The sky is no longer the limit! Traverse the galaxy to locate resources or meet your friends. Refine ores to build spacecraft, and increasingly elaborate industrial complexes. Explore thousands of stars and their countless planets.

Created by Calzymp

Alpha 10:
Changelog so massive I cant possibly list everything but I will summarize as:
Complete universe rework from galaxies, nebulas, stars, planets, ect.
New ocean and desert plants.
Interstellar Space and skybox overhaul/rework.
Data reset.
